name: Child Support Caseload and Collections
description: This dataset tracks child support program activity over time, broken out by indicator, case type, and date. It contains 1,189 rows and six columns: indicator, case_type, date, caseload, percentage, and dollars. The caseload column records counts of child support cases, percentage captures a related rate or share, and dollars records monetary amounts such as collections. Because the data is organized by indicator and case type, it can be filtered to compare specific measures across case categories and time periods. It is useful for monitoring trends in child support caseloads and collections, comparing performance across case types, and supporting reporting or analysis by social services agencies, researchers, and policy analysts.
